title: R’ Chananyah, Brother of Rabbi Acha son of Rabbi Chanina
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 17:2, but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be as the statement is cited in Tanchuma, Shelach 27: “R’ Tanchuma bar Abba in the name of R’ Chanina, the father of R’ Acha.”[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Numbers Rabbah 17:2 text calls Rabbi Chanina the brother of Rabbi Acha ben Rabbi Chanina. The opening discourse of Buber Tanchuma, Shelach 27, instead calls Chanina the father of Acha bar Chanina. Standard Tanchuma’s returned chapter structure has fifteen Shelach sections, and the attempted standard Shelach 27 request was unavailable. Hyman’s edition-unspecific citation and “should read” correction remain his argument; the two relationships are not merged. His Chananyah heading is retained without harmonizing it to Chanina.
